subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate conjunction:**

The software update enhanced performance; _______, it introduced several compatibility issues.
solution:
The correct answer is '**nevertheless**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The conjunction "**nevertheless**" is used to introduce a contrasting idea or statement.
 
• In this sentence, the software update enhanced performance, but it also introduced compatibility issues, which is a contrasting point.
 
• Options 2, 3,
